title: PREPARING FOR A CURSE THAT WOULD NOT COME

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath Huzoth. Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and gave some to Balaam and the officials who were with him. The next morning Balak took Balaam up to Bamoth Baal, and from there he could see the outskirts of the Israelite camp. - Num 22:39-41 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter closes with elaborate preparations. Balak offers sacrifices and shares the meat with Balaam and the officials. Then he takes Balaam up to a high place, Bamoth Baal, where they can look down on the edge of the Israelite camp. Everything is being arranged for the curse Balak so desperately wants.

But we, the readers, already know something Balak does not. God has declared Israel blessed. All these sacrifices, all this climbing to high places, all this careful staging will not produce a single curse. The scheme is doomed before it begins, though the schemers do not yet realise it.

There is a certain sadness in watching Balak invest so much in something that cannot succeed. How often do people pour their energy, resources, and hopes into efforts that stand against God's purposes? All the striving in the world cannot overturn what the Lord has determined. It is labour spent against the immovable.

Down below, Israel sleeps in their tents, entirely unaware of the drama on the heights above them. They did nothing to secure this protection; God did it all. And so it is for those in Christ. While unseen battles rage, we rest in a safety we did not earn, guarded by a God who never sleeps (Ps 121:3-4). His blessing over His people cannot be undone.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where might people pour effort into schemes that cannot overturn God's will?
2. How does it comfort you that God guards His people even while they sleep?
3. What unearned protection has God given you in Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You watch over Your people even when we are unaware of the battles around us. Help me rest in the blessing and protection I have in Christ, which no scheme can undo. Amen.
